summary_de: Churchill, türkischer Çay, Lotus Cheesecake und Oreo-Eis – kurze Produktvideos, die Lust auf die Karte machen.
summary_en: Churchill, Turkish çay, Lotus cheesecake and Oreo ice cream – short product videos that make you want to order.
summary_tr: Churchill, Türk çayı, Lotus cheesecake ve Oreo dondurma – menüye iştah açan kısa ürün videoları.
task_de: Einzelne Drinks und Desserts von der Karte so zeigen, dass man sie sofort bestellen möchte – für Social Media, Anzeigen und Bildschirme vor Ort.
task_en: Show individual drinks and desserts from the menu so that people want to order them straight away – for social media, ads and screens on site.
solution_de: Ein kurzes Video pro Produkt, vor dunklem Hintergrund und nah an Glas, Eis und Soße. Querformat für Bildschirme, Hochformat für Reels und Stories.
solution_en: One short video per product, against a dark background and close to the glass, ice and sauce. Landscape for screens, vertical for reels and stories.
solution_tr: Her ürün için koyu arka planda; bardağa, buza ve sosa yakın kısa bir video. Ekranlar için yatay, Reels ve Stories için dikey.
